name: PrMarketingAgent
description: Explains GitHub pull requests in plain English for marketing, decides whether each change is post-worthy, and drafts posts, release notes, briefs, blogs, emails and weekly digests from your templates. Runs on demand for one PR or on a schedule over recently merged PRs. Every draft needs human approval.

triggers.name: pr_url
triggers.description: On-demand: the pull request URL, e.g. https://github.com/acme/web/pull/412.

triggers.name: repos
triggers.description: Scheduled: repositories to scan, one owner/name per line.

triggers.name: lookback_days
triggers.description: Scheduled: days to look back on the first run (later runs continue from the last run).

triggers.name: formats
triggers.description: Comma-separated: linkedin_post, x_post, release_notes, marketing_brief, blog_draft, email_announcement. Empty on-demand = the agent's recommendation; empty scheduled = digest only.

triggers.name: force_generate
triggers.description: Write drafts even when the change is judged internal or on hold.

triggers.name: extra_context
triggers.description: Optional context for the writer, e.g. launch event or target audience. Treated as unverified.
